ideas.pitch: A localized mobile and web dashboard that maps overflowing public waste bins and unmanaged dumping spots, automatically optimizing collection routes for municipal workers or local volunteers.
ideas.title: EcoRoute: Community Waste & Sanitation Dispatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets UN Sustainable Development Goal 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities) and mirrors the proven social-good impact of previous winning entries like EcoSaathi and WasteX.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first mobile application tailored for local panchayats to monitor public water tap assets, log periodic water quality test results, and report pipe leaks with photo uploads.
ideas.title: JalNet: Rural Water Asset & Quality Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with UN SDG 6 (Clean Water and Sanitation) and uses the exact framework of asset and resource management that won runner-up at the Smart India Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A mobile utility that lets users scan product barcodes at grocery stores or home to instantly display local disposal instructions, material breakdown, and carbon footprint reduction tips.
ideas.title: GreenLens: Instant Recyclability Barcode Scanner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses UN SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production) while replicating the exact winning formula of Sunhacks Best Hack winner 'garbage-scan'.

ideas.pitch: A quick-response web portal that connects local smallholder farmers with nearby food banks and markets to list surplus produce before it spoils, minimizing food waste.
ideas.title: AgriSustain: Local Farm Supply & Surplus Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles UN SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) and SDG 12 by offering a quantified social benefit and clear economic incentive for local communities.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight mapping tool enabling citizens in disaster-prone regions to crowd-source blocked roads, flooded areas, and fallen power lines using low-bandwidth SMS integration or local mesh networks.
ideas.title: DisasterRoute: Offline Emergency Hazard Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with UN SDG 13 (Climate Action) and follows the proven success pattern of real-time disaster management platforms like Oarfin.
